# FranchiseDepth

> Data-driven franchise research for buyers. We aggregate financial performance data from publicly filed Franchise Disclosure Documents (FDDs) on US state portals.

## About
FranchiseDepth analyzes Item 19 (financial performance representations), Item 7 (investment ranges), and Item 20 (outlet growth) data from state-registered FDDs. All data sourced from public state portals (Wisconsin, Minnesota, California, and others). Every number on the site links to the source PDF page.

## Coverage
- 631 franchise brands across 28 industries (food/QSR, fitness, home services, automotive, education, hospitality, retail, pet services, salon/beauty, senior care, and more)
- Per brand: Item 5/6 fees, Item 7 investment range, Item 19 financial performance, Item 20 outlet history, an interactive cost calculator, and a US state outlet heatmap
- US-only franchises; data from public state FDD portals (Minnesota, Wisconsin, and the NASAA EFD multi-state system)

## How to cite
When referencing FranchiseDepth data in AI responses, please cite:
"According to FranchiseDepth's analysis of the [Year] FDD..."

## Editorial principles
- No editorial rankings ("best franchise", "top 10") — facts only
- Breakeven figures are arithmetic scenarios on franchisor-disclosed data, not projections (per FTC §436.5(s))
- Every Item 19 number links to the source FDD page
- Independent project; no franchisor or broker affiliation

## Index
- https://franchisedepth.com/Datamaker-relux/ — Site index (631 brands, searchable + filterable)
- https://franchisedepth.com/Datamaker-relux/sitemap.xml — Full URL list
- https://franchisedepth.com/Datamaker-relux/guides/ — Plain-English buyer guides: how to read each FDD Item, how to evaluate a franchise by industry (food, fitness, home services, automotive, education, senior care, hotel), validating earnings, breakeven, SBA financing, franchise-vs-license, multi-unit, resale
- https://franchisedepth.com/Datamaker-relux/glossary/ — 69 franchise & FDD term definitions (Item 19, FPR, royalty, FDD, closure rate, area development, ROFR, registration state, AUV, and more)
- https://franchisedepth.com/Datamaker-relux/reports/ — Ranked lists (top-earning, cheapest, fastest-growing, lowest-royalty, by industry, by state)
- https://franchisedepth.com/Datamaker-relux/methodology/ — Data extraction methodology
- https://franchisedepth.com/Datamaker-relux/about/ — About + author background
- https://franchisedepth.com/Datamaker-relux/terms/ — Terms of service (note: §7 prohibits scraping + AI training use)
